substantive_delta: A fully charged extension algorithm combines input-sensitive capped witness acquisition with the prior frequency decomposition, converts its edgewise quotient gauges into genuine complete kernel instances despite nonhomomorphic lift carries, and closes a finite induction for every fixed exponent M with a saving independent of c. This resolves the full source question without a sparse-triangle, small-dimension, residue-degree or preprocessed-universe promise.
why_nonroutine: The literal prior decomposition has cubic fresh-input initialization and therefore cannot simply be cited as a subcubic algorithm; the elementary backend alone does not distinguish kernel obstructions. The new closure step jointly removes that construction bottleneck, uses actual assigned quotient witnesses to obtain edgewise potentials, cancels carries before kernel division, and pays for all complete instances throughout induction. These operations establish a new algorithmic extension principle on arbitrary inputs, not merely the elementary group isomorphism or an isolated consequence of the restricted p^2 theorems. Its components remain attributed prior work, and its novelty is assessed as a combined extension theorem rather than as a new decomposition or listing theorem.
significance: The result removes the elementary-versus-non-elementary limitation for the entire bounded-exponent Exact Triangle class, including the unrestricted logarithmic-dimensional Z_4 case and all higher or mixed fixed exponents. Its reusable quotient/kernel mechanism supplies substantive qualitative algorithmic value. The exponents are extremely small, no practical advantage is claimed, and competitive STOC significance is separately uncertain: the venue label is working_paper.
